req.title: Player deletion persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall remove the row from the players table so GET returns 404 afterwards.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that DELETE /players/{playerId} (implemented as DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}) must remove the row from the players table so a subsequent GET returns 404. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing player and verify 204 then 404 on re-fetch; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent player and verify 404; (3) boundary BVA — delete the lowest squad number (1) and highest (26) to catch off-by-one mutations; (4) STC — full state transition: exists → deleted → re-delete returns 404; (5) DT — verify the deleted player is absent from the full collection listing. Each test uses exact status code assertions and verifies both sides of the state transition to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=10 exists in the database (Kabir Mary Reddy)
expected: Subsequent GET returns HTTP 404 Not Found
Persistence is confirmed — row is gone from DB
trace: R-PLAYER-021: system shall remove the row so GET returns 404 afterwards
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404():
    delete_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert delete_resp.status_code == 204
    assert delete_resp.content == b''
    get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404()

tests.name: test_delete_player_state_transition_exists_to_deleted_to_redelete
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=15 (Priya Chopra) exists in the database
actions: Verify player exists via GET /players/squadnumber/15 (state: EXISTS)
expected: Initial GET returns 200 confirming player exists
trace: R-PLAYER-021: state transition — player moves from existing to deleted; re-deletion must return 404
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_player_state_transition_exists_to_deleted_to_redelete():
    pre_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/15')
    assert pre_resp.status_code == 200
    assert pre_resp.json()['squadNumber'] == 15
    del_resp1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/15')
    assert del_resp1.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/15')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404
    del_resp2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/15')
    assert del_resp2.status_code == 404
    assert del_resp2.status_code != 204

test_delete_player_state_transition_exists_to_deleted_to_redelete()

tests.name: test_delete_player_absent_from_collection_after_deletion
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=7 (Ishaan Iyer) exists in the database
actions: Send GET /players/ to retrieve full collection
Assert no player in the list has squadNumber=7
Assert total count decreased by exactly 1 (25 players remain)
expected: No player with squadNumber=7 in the collection
trace: R-PLAYER-021: row removed from players table — verified via collection endpoint
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_player_absent_from_collection_after_deletion():
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/7')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    list_resp = client.get('/players/')
    assert list_resp.status_code == 200
    players = list_resp.json()
    squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in players]
    assert 7 not in squad_numbers
    assert len(players) == 25

test_delete_player_absent_from_collection_after_deletion()

tests.name: test_delete_player_by_uuid_get_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squadNumber=20 (Reyansh Shah, id=3f760606-760f-4c31-bbcf-de3b8d30dee3) exists
actions: Send GET /players/{uuid} using the known UUID of the deleted player
expected: GET by UUID returns 404 confirming row is gone from DB at the persistence layer
trace: R-PLAYER-021: row removed from players table — verified via UUID lookup endpoint
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_player_by_uuid_get_returns_404():
    player_uuid = '3f760606-760f-4c31-bbcf-de3b8d30dee3'
    pre_resp = client.get(f'/players/{player_uuid}')
    assert pre_resp.status_code == 200
    assert pre_resp.json()['squadNumber'] == 20
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/20')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get(f'/players/{player_uuid}')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

test_delete_player_by_uuid_get_returns_404()
